_comment: Cloud routine definition for Claude Code (claude.ai/code/routines). Submit with the RemoteTrigger tool, action create. Requires the GitHub account to be connected on claude.ai and SUPABASE_URL plus SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY set on the cloud environment.
name: EEVA draft reports for new intakes

message.content:
You are running as an hourly routine for New Paradigm Trauma Institute. Your job: find new emotional-evaluation intake submissions in the Supabase database that have no report yet, write a draft Emotional Evaluation and Treatment Plan for each, and attach the PDF to the client's record marked DRAFT for human review. Work only inside the cloned repository EEVA-Database.

SETUP
1. Read CLAUDE.md and README.md in the repository root first. CLAUDE.md holds every clinical and formatting rule for the report text and is binding. README.md explains the tooling.
2. Run `npm install`.
3. Confirm the environment variables SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY are set (`node -e "console.log(!!process.env.SUPABASE_URL, !!process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY)"`). If either is missing, stop and report that the cloud environment needs them; do nothing else.
4. Check that `soffice` is available for PDF conversion. If it is not, try `sudo apt-get install -y libreoffice-writer` (or without sudo). If LibreOffice cannot be installed, still write the report and build the .docx, then report that the PDF step failed; do not attach a .docx.

FIND WORK
5. Run `node supabase-db.js pending 7`. This lists evaluations from the last 7 days whose client has no EEVA report attached.
6. SKIP any entry that is a test submission: client email nino@ninovega.com or dirk.paeshuys@gmail.com, client name exactly "Dirk", or a current_situation that is clearly placeholder text (for example "Hhh", "test", random letters). Also skip entries with no selected statements at all. List skipped entries in your final summary with the reason.
7. If nothing remains, finish with a one-line summary saying no new intakes needed a report.

FOR EACH REMAINING CLIENT (process the most recent evaluation per client only)
8. Run `node supabase-db.js client "<client name>"` to get the full client record and evaluations. Use only the information it returns. Do not invent facts.
9. Write the report content as JSON following report-content.example.json exactly in structure, into reports/<surname-lowercase>.json. Follow every rule in CLAUDE.md: twelve headings in the stated order, compassionate second-person tone addressed to the client by first name, Emotional Load Score = (score_raw / 45) x 100 shown with the score and the percentage to one decimal place and the note that an ideal load is below 15%, no em dash characters, no horizontal lines, no unsupported diagnoses, no promises of recovery. Scores table rows come from selected_categories (count of statements per category) and total from score_raw. Where the intake leaves a field empty (country, situation text, diagnosis, medication, hospital admission) say plainly that it was not provided and will be gathered at the suitability consultation. Because no human has told you the program type or dates, recommend the option that best fits the presentation (14-day inpatient, outpatient intensive therapy, online EMDR therapy, or inpatient followed by online aftercare), explain why, and write all dates as to be confirmed at the suitability consultation. The subtitle lines should state the proposed program and that dates are to be confirmed. Prepared-by line is exactly: Prepared by Dirk J. Lambert, Trauma/EMDR Specialist and Program Director.
10. Build the Word file: `node build-report.js reports/<surname>.json "reports/EEVA - <Client Name> - <DDMMYYYY>.docx"` using today's date in UTC as DDMMYYYY. If the builder rejects an em dash, fix the JSON and rebuild.
11. Convert: `node convert-pdf.js "reports/<file>.docx" "reports/<file>.pdf"`.
12. Sanity-check the PDF text with `pdftotext` if available (all twelve headings present, no em dash, Client Information begins the last page).
13. Attach as a draft: `node supabase-db.js attach "<client name>" eevas "reports/<file>.pdf" DRAFT`. The client name must match exactly one client; if it matches several, use the most specific full name from step 8. Never attach without the DRAFT prefix.

RULES
- Never commit, push, open pull requests, or modify files outside reports/. Report files contain health data and must stay out of git (reports/ is already ignored).
- Never write to any database table other than attachments, and never delete anything.
- Never attach a second report for a client who already has one; the pending command already excludes them, so trust it.
- If anything fails for one client, continue with the others and describe the failure in the summary.

FINAL MESSAGE
End with a short summary: for each client processed give the name, score and percentage, the recommended option, and the attached label; then the skipped entries with reasons; then any failures. Remind the reader that drafts need review in the dashboard before being sent to clients.
